source_name: DCAD Data Products — certified appraisal rolls, ownership, notices, ARB data
verification_note: Data products URL, GIS parcel-geometry guide (wwur.dallascad.org/PARCEL_GEOM.pdf), and maps.dcad.org help page appeared in search results 2026-08-25.
data_format: large ZIP archives with documented field layouts
update_frequency: annual certification (2026 real + BPP rolls certified 2026-07-24) + supplemental change files; current-ownership files refreshed
terms_notes: Distinguish current vs certified vs supplemental vs notice vs historical files — a current file reflects post-certification changes.
difficulty_reason: Official free bulk rolls with layout docs; matching GIS data on the GIS products page.
notes: NON-DISCLOSURE: DCAD files contain values/ownership/characteristics but NO sale prices — Texas sale prices are not public record in Dallas County. Substitutes: recorded deed-of-trust amounts, MLS-derived comps. 100% market value as of Jan 1, annual reappraisal, PTAD ratio-tested.

source_name: County Clerk Official Public Record Search (publicsearch.us) + Kofile pre-1964
verification_note: publicsearch.us URL, kofilequicklinks.com/dallas/, and clerk recording-division pages appeared 2026-08-25.
cost: index search free; copy/certification fees for official copies
terms_notes: Records 1964-present online; 1846-1963 via Kofile link on the search page.
difficulty_reason: Free index but UI-driven; no bulk index export surfaced.
notes: NO TRANSFER TAX in Texas — recording fees only, statutory under Loc. Gov. Code ch. 118 (~$25 first page + ~$4/page). Deeds show no consideration (non-disclosure); deed-of-trust amounts ARE recorded and serve as the loan-size price proxy.
